parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description: The main streaming domain for which you want to modify the configuration of real-time log delivery.

parameters.name: Logstore
parameters.description: The name of the Logstore to which log entries are delivered.

parameters.name: Project
parameters.description: The name of the Log Service project that is used for real-time log delivery.

parameters.name: Region
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the Log Service project is deployed.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live modify-live-realtime-log-delivery --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --project project_example --logstore logstore_example --biz-region cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live ModifyLiveRealtimeLogDelivery --region cn-hangzhou --Project project_example --DomainName 'example.com' --Logstore logstore_example --Region 'cn-hangzhou' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
